obligation: attachment transport and cross-cone route/coherencer compatibility
domain: All 224 recorded producer-comparison to consumer-reference contacts, with all producer/consumer sign bindings and both consumer channel appearances retained.
classification: Determine whether the downstream item is an operation port or a reference-value field. Compare the exposed types before applying cyclic duality or re-rooting.
candidateRefinement: Restrict the downstream reference value to valid full comparison packets of the specified upstream occurrence and cell. Carry the packet literally as the existing channelOperand payload; no header projection or wrapper transformation.
globalOrder: Construct the complete contextual attachment family and all prepared source points before testing local restrictions. This is not a construction of the whole eighty-fibre physical state by growing readers.
twoVertexTest: The upstream compareAt operation and the downstream channelOperand operation form the two vertices. Match the complete upstream result with the refined downstream reference value. Check reconstruction in both directions, retaining all upstream histories inside the downstream payload.
hostiles: A scalar accepted by the unrefined JSON reference slot is not an upstream comparison packet
Header-only substitution fails the refined fibre
Wrong source occurrence fails even when the physical cell agrees
A wrapped but recoverable packet does not satisfy literal-content preservation
nonverification: This tests one uniform API-derived refinement and its literal-content inclusion. It does not establish that the existing physical fibration selects this refinement, identifies distinct producer contexts, or supplies global higher fillers. The periodic edge-three wiring is audited separately, not imposed on edge-five.
